beats.headline: Stop paying your accountant overtime to type 9 hotel registers.
beats.say: Stop paying your accountant overtime to type nine hotel registers.

beats.label: 3 YOUR CA ASKS FOR
beats.say: At month end, your C A asks for three registers first. Here's where each one comes from.

beats.label: 1/3 PURCHASE
beats.say: One. The purchase register. Every supplier bill, with the tax split already done.

beats.label: 2/3 SALE BILL
beats.say: Two. The sale bill register. Every room and restaurant bill you raised.

beats.label: 3/3 GST
beats.say: Three. The G S T register. A room bill is C G S T plus S G S T, whatever state the guest is from.

beats.label: THEN
beats.say: Discounts come off before tax. Then tap export, and each register is an Excel file.

beats.headline: Send this to your accountant
beats.say: Send this to your accountant. Then stop typing nine registers.
